context: Asuka explains a grammar point; Sho-young is the young learner.
purpose: Teacher patiently explaining connectives to a child.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 翔くん、「つまり」って言葉、知ってる?
lines.en: Sho, do you know the word "in other words"?
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm gentle delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん、ちょっと、難しい。
lines.style: soft child boy voice, warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 前の話を、まとめる時に使うのよ。
lines.en: You use it to sum up what came before.
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm instructive delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: curious child boy voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 「しかも」は、付け加える時。例えば、こうよ。
lines.en: "Moreover" is for adding on. Like this, for example.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm explanatory delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 全く分からなかったけど、少し分かった!
lines.en: I didn't get it at all, but now I sort of do!
lines.style: bright child boy voice, soft warm cheerful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そこで、もう一回、練習してみようね。
lines.en: So then, let's practice once more.
lines.style: tender teacher voice, soft warm patient delivery carefully
